l2_pmr.quote: By Lugano 2014 criteria this is a partial metabolic response (PMR), not a complete metabolic response

l2_repeat_biopsy.quote: I recommend a repeat image-guided core biopsy of the residual retroperitoneal mass, targeting the most FDG-avid peripheral portion

l2_respect_refusal.quote: This shared decision balances the risk of overtreating a possibly cured patient against the risk of missing residual aggressive lymphoma

l2_short_interval_pet_or_rt.quote: then a repeat FDG PET-CT in 6-8 weeks (roughly late March to mid-April 2027)

l2_no_cns_action.quote: Routine surveillance lumbar puncture or MRI in an asymptomatic patient with a negative baseline CNS evaluation is not indicated.

l2_car_t_awareness.quote: A positive biopsy would confirm residual DLBCL and prompt second-line platinum-based salvage with a view to autologous transplant or CAR-T
l2_car_t_awareness.note: Mentions CAR-T candidacy but leads with platinum salvage/ASCT and no early cellular-therapy referral.

l2_mn_salvage_without_histology.quote: I would not start empirical salvage therapy on the basis of Deauville 4 alone.
